edge_kinds.composition: to = Σ sign·from (catalogue formula, verified daily on Cube)
edge_kinds.declared_input: to is computed from `from`, role not stated (catalogue depends_on only)
edge_kinds.twin: same quantity on another date basis or grain (concept axes); never both in one causal model
edge_kinds.co_measure: same events counted by another system; a divergence is a data observation, not a cause
edge_kinds.subset: from ⊂ to (part of the same events)
edge_kinds.allocation: to is a model share of `from`, keyed on revenue; never a driver of the same entity's revenue
edge_kinds.mechanism: business prior: a move in `from` drives `to` (direction certain, size for the data to show)
edge_kinds.feedback: lagged reaction of a lever to results (budget / bidding)

nodes.label: Checkout fee

nodes.label: Collection view events

nodes.label: CPM
nodes.formula: Cost per 1,000 impressions.

nodes.label: CTR
nodes.formula: Click-through rate = clicks ÷ impressions.

nodes.label: Customers

nodes.label: Discounts

nodes.label: Discounts incl tax
nodes.formula: Discounts incl. GST; tax-inclusive (D-02b).

nodes.label: Add-to-cart events (events)
nodes.formula: Add-to-cart events (event grain) — by product, SKU, traffic source or campaign.

nodes.label: Collection views (events)

nodes.label: Web events (events)
nodes.formula: Events (event grain).

nodes.label: Page views (events)
nodes.formula: Page views (event grain) — by page, product, traffic source or campaign.

nodes.label: Product views (events)
nodes.formula: Product views (event grain) — by product, SKU, traffic source or campaign.

nodes.label: Site searches (events)
nodes.formula: Site searches (event grain) — by page, traffic source or campaign.

nodes.label: Events per session
nodes.formula: Events per session.

nodes.label: Exchange cost
nodes.formula: Net cost of exchange fulfilment: replacement product cost less credits and recovered stock, plus exchange shipping and handling (D-01).

nodes.label: Exchange credit amount
nodes.formula: Non-cash exchange credits on exchange replacements (gateway manual / store credit …); internal transfers, not cash (D-01b).

nodes.label: Exchange price adjustment
nodes.formula: Exchange value difference (replacement minus exchanged item), ex-GST, on the original sale (D-01a).

nodes.label: Exchange refund count
nodes.formula: Refund events on orders whose items were exchanged (kept visible, outside the return metrics, D-01 / D-20).

nodes.label: Funnel purchases (orders)
nodes.formula: Funnel purchases at order grain (the mart's purchases, sliceable by campaign and product).

nodes.label: Funnel revenue (orders)
nodes.formula: Revenue of the funnel purchases at order grain (net revenue ex-tax, the mart's revenue).

nodes.label: Funnel purchases
nodes.formula: Purchases seen in the web funnel (Snowplow) — not the orders count.

nodes.label: Funnel revenue
nodes.formula: Revenue of funnel purchases (Snowplow).

nodes.label: Gross COGS
nodes.formula: Product (landed purchase) cost of all placed units, no return adjustment (D-03).

nodes.label: Gross profit
nodes.formula: Gross profit = gross sales − gross COGS − ad spend.

nodes.label: Gross ROAS
nodes.formula: Gross ROAS = gross sales (attributed at placement) ÷ ad spend (D-09).

nodes.label: Gross sales
nodes.formula: Gross sales ex-GST at placement, after discounts (D-09a). Same figure as finance.gross_sales.

nodes.label: Hold rate (15 s)
nodes.formula: Hold rate = ThruPlays (15 s) ÷ 3-second video views (Meta).

nodes.label: Hook rate
nodes.formula: Hook rate = 3-second video views ÷ impressions (Meta).

nodes.label: Impressions
nodes.formula: Impressions.

nodes.label: Inventory sync errors
nodes.formula: Inventory posting failures.

nodes.label: Items with layer gap
nodes.formula: Items whose balance disagrees with their FIFO layers (usually unlayered manual adjustments); their FIFO value is understated.

nodes.label: Landing page views
nodes.formula: Landing page views = website sessions attributed to the platform / campaign / ad (UTM / click id) with at least one tracked page view (D-17, D-13r). Not the platform-reported figure. Sessions without a campaign / ad id sit on the 'campaign unknown' / 'ad unknown' members.

nodes.label: Layered units
nodes.formula: On-hand units that sit in open FIFO layers (the part of on_hand_units that stock_value_fifo values).

nodes.label: Line fill rate
nodes.formula: Received / ordered units on the lines.

nodes.label: Line ordered units
nodes.formula: Units ordered on the lines.

nodes.label: Line received units
nodes.formula: Units received (QC actual).

nodes.label: Line value
nodes.formula: Line value incl. GST.

nodes.label: Link clicks
nodes.formula: Link clicks.

nodes.label: LTV
nodes.formula: LTV = first-order net sales ex-GST of new customers ÷ new customers, by channel / campaign (v1 definition, cohort-only: refused on event_date, D-31).

nodes.label: LTV:CAC ratio
nodes.formula: LTV ÷ CAC (cohort-only; mixed clocks, refused on event_date, D-31 owner-confirmed 2026-10-15).

nodes.label: MER
nodes.formula: MER = net sales ÷ ad spend. NULL when net sales <= 0; on the event axis it is labelled (D-31).

nodes.label: Movement value
nodes.formula: Signed movement value at the movement's unit cost.

nodes.label: Net AOV
nodes.formula: Net AOV ex-GST = net sales ÷ orders. Mixed clocks: refused on event_date (D-31, owner-confirmed 2026-10-15).

nodes.label: Net COGS
nodes.formula: Net COGS = product cost + operating cost + exchange cost, net of returns.

nodes.label: Net margin %
nodes.formula: Contribution after ads ÷ net sales. NULL when net sales <= 0; labelled on the event axis (D-31).

nodes.label: Net profit
nodes.formula: Contribution after ads = contribution margin − ad spend. Opex is not in the warehouse, so this is not a true net profit (D-18, D-18r).

nodes.label: Net ROAS
nodes.formula: Net ROAS = contribution before ads ÷ ad spend. NULL when net sales <= 0; labelled on the event axis (D-31).

nodes.label: Net sales
nodes.formula: Net sales ex-GST (ledger): gross + shipping − cancelled − RTO − returned − shipping reversed ± exchange adjustment. Equals finance.net_sales.

nodes.label: Net sales deductions
nodes.formula: What net sales deducts: cancelled, RTO, returned and reversed shipping, ex-GST.

nodes.label: Net stock change
nodes.formula: Net units change (in minus out) over the period.

nodes.label: LTV (by channel / campaign)
nodes.formula: LTV by channel / campaign = first-order net sales ex-GST ÷ new customers (cohort-only, D-31).

nodes.label: New customer net sales
nodes.formula: Net sales ex-GST of first orders of new customers (numerator of ltv). Cohort-only (D-31).

nodes.label: New customers
nodes.formula: First placed orders of new customers (D-15).

nodes.label: On hand units
nodes.formula: Units on hand now.

nodes.label: Open inventory sync errors
nodes.formula: Posting failures not yet resolved.

nodes.label: Open purchase orders
nodes.formula: Purchase requests not yet fulfilled.

nodes.label: Operating cost
nodes.formula: Fulfilment and payment cost = shipping + packaging + gateway + COD + checkout + weight + provisional + reverse shipping.

nodes.label: Ad spend (P&L basis)
nodes.formula: Ad spend on delivery date, never allocated (D-07). Ignores date_axis.

nodes.label: Cancel revenue (P&L basis)
nodes.formula: Sales cancelled before dispatch ex-GST (positive deduction); Unknown outcomes are booked here (D-22h).

nodes.label: Discounts (P&L basis)
nodes.formula: Discounts ex-GST. Memo: already deducted inside gross_sales (D-09a), so not subtracted again in net sales.

nodes.label: Gross sales (P&L basis)
nodes.formula: Gross sales ex-GST at placement, after discounts (D-09a); the top line. Excludes shipping charged.

nodes.label: Net sales (P&L basis)
nodes.formula: Net sales ex-GST = gross sales + shipping revenue − cancelled − RTO − returned − shipping reversed ± exchange price adjustment.

nodes.label: Return cancel revenue (P&L basis)
nodes.formula: Cancelled + RTO + returned sales ex-GST: everything the old return+cancel id covered (v2 hid RTO inside it).

nodes.label: Return revenue (P&L basis)
nodes.formula: Sales of delivered orders returned by the customer ex-GST (positive deduction).

nodes.label: Rto revenue (P&L basis)
nodes.formula: Sales of shipped orders that came back undelivered (RTO) ex-GST (positive deduction). Separate from cancels and returns since v3 (D-05, D-22).

nodes.label: Order value incl tax
nodes.formula: Order value incl. GST at placement; tax-inclusive (D-02b).

nodes.label: Orders
nodes.formula: Sale orders placed. Exchange replacements, zero-value and test orders are not sales (D-01 / D-08).

nodes.label: Orders with touchpoints
nodes.formula: Orders with at least one recorded touch.

nodes.label: Out of stock items
nodes.formula: Items with nothing available (available <= 0).

nodes.label: Overdue purchase orders
nodes.formula: Open purchase requests past their expected delivery date.

nodes.label: Packaging cost
nodes.formula: Packaging cost (placed).

nodes.label: Page views
nodes.formula: Page views.

nodes.label: Paid sales
nodes.formula: What customers paid at placement INCLUDING GST, after discounts; tax-inclusive (D-02b).

nodes.label: Payment amount
nodes.formula: Cash payment amount (refunds negative). Non-cash exchange credits are separate (exchange_credit_amount, D-01b). Native cash clock (transaction date, D-36).

nodes.label: Payment gateway fees
nodes.formula: Payment gateway fees (placed, net as gold posts them).

nodes.label: Payment orders
nodes.formula: Sale orders with a recognised payment bucket (cod / online / manual / paytm card machine), as v2.

nodes.label: Platform reported landing page views
nodes.formula: Landing page views as the ad platform reports them. Diagnostic twin of landing_page_views, hidden by default (D-13r); never an ad metric.

nodes.label: Po count
nodes.formula: Purchase requests.

nodes.label: Po fill rate
nodes.formula: Received / ordered units (QC actual quantity).

nodes.label: Po lines
nodes.formula: Purchase request lines.

nodes.label: Po ordered units
nodes.formula: Units ordered.

nodes.label: Po received units
nodes.formula: Units received per quality check.

nodes.label: Po value
nodes.formula: PO value incl. GST and header freight.

nodes.label: Prepaid orders
nodes.formula: Prepaid (online) sale orders.

nodes.label: Product ad spend (allocated)
nodes.formula: Ad spend allocated to the product line: each campaign-day's delivery spread over the credited sale lines of that day by credit × line gross sales (D-27). A model, not platform-reported. Unallocated spend is its own 'Unallocated' row so totals reconcile with delivery.

nodes.label: Product attributed contribution (allocated)
nodes.formula: Contribution before ads of the product's ad-attributed lines.

nodes.label: Product attributed net sales (allocated)
nodes.formula: Net sales ex-GST of the product's ad-attributed lines.

nodes.label: Product attributed revenue (allocated)
nodes.formula: Gross sales ex-GST of the product's ad-attributed lines (default attribution model).

nodes.label: Product break-even ROAS (allocated)
nodes.formula: Product break-even ROAS = attributed net sales ÷ attributed contribution before ads.

nodes.label: Product CAC (allocated)
nodes.formula: Product CAC = allocated ad spend ÷ first-time-customer orders containing the product (paid-credited and organic lines, D-38).

nodes.label: Product clicks (allocated)
nodes.formula: Clicks allocated to the product line.

nodes.label: Product cogs credit
nodes.formula: Product cost credited back for every cancelled / RTO / returned unit (D-03a); follows its deduction on the event axis (D-30).

nodes.label: Product contribution margin
nodes.formula: Contribution before ads = net sales − net COGS.

nodes.label: Product contribution margin %
nodes.formula: Contribution margin ÷ net sales. NULL when net sales <= 0; labelled on the event axis (D-31).

nodes.formula: Product cost net of the restock credit.

nodes.formula: Allocated spend ÷ allocated website landing page views.

nodes.label: Product cost per link click (allocated)
nodes.formula: Allocated cost per link click.

nodes.label: Product cost per order (CPA) (allocated)

nodes.label: Product CPC (allocated)
nodes.formula: Allocated cost per click.

nodes.label: Product CPM (allocated)
nodes.formula: Allocated cost per 1,000 impressions.

nodes.label: Product CTR (allocated)
nodes.formula: Allocated CTR.

nodes.label: Product gross cogs
nodes.formula: Product (landed purchase) cost of all placed units, no return adjustment (D-03).

nodes.label: Product gross ROAS (allocated)
nodes.formula: Product gross ROAS = attributed gross sales ÷ allocated ad spend.

nodes.label: Product hold rate 15s (allocated)
nodes.formula: Allocated ThruPlays ÷ 3-second views.

nodes.label: Product hook rate (allocated)
nodes.formula: Allocated 3-second video views ÷ impressions.

nodes.label: Product impressions (allocated)
nodes.formula: Impressions allocated to the product line.

nodes.label: Product LPVs (allocated)
nodes.formula: Website landing page views allocated by the same rule as spend (D-27b); not the platform figure.

nodes.label: Product link clicks (allocated)
nodes.formula: Link clicks allocated to the product line.

nodes.formula: Product LTV:CAC = net sales ex-GST of first-time-customer lines of the product ÷ its allocated ad spend (the brand LTV:CAC basis at product grain).

nodes.label: Product MER (allocated)
nodes.formula: Product MER = attributed net sales ÷ allocated ad spend.

nodes.label: Product net margin % (allocated)
nodes.formula: Product net margin = contribution after allocated ads ÷ attributed net sales.

nodes.label: Product net profit (allocated)
nodes.formula: Product contribution after allocated ads = attributed contribution before ads − allocated ad spend (opex excluded, D-18r).

nodes.label: Product net ROAS (allocated)
nodes.formula: Product net ROAS = attributed contribution before ads ÷ allocated ad spend.

nodes.label: Product new customers
nodes.formula: Distinct first-time-customer orders containing the product (D-15).

nodes.label: Product operating cost
nodes.formula: Fulfilment and payment cost = shipping + packaging + gateway + COD + checkout + weight + provisional + reverse shipping.

nodes.label: Product ad spend (P&L basis) (allocated)
nodes.formula: Allocated ad spend of the orders containing the product (as product_ad_spend; the id the product P&L used).

nodes.label: Product cancel revenue (P&L basis)
nodes.formula: Sales cancelled before dispatch ex-GST (positive deduction); Unknown outcomes are booked here (D-22h).

nodes.label: Product cancelled orders (P&L basis)
nodes.formula: Distinct orders with a cancelled (or Unknown) line of the product; on the event axis each counts on the date of its own line event (D-37).

nodes.label: Product checkout fee (P&L basis)
nodes.formula: Checkout fee; not recorded before 2026-09 (D-11a).

nodes.label: Product cod handling fee (P&L basis)
nodes.formula: COD handling fee; not recorded before 2026-09 (cost_method not_recorded, D-11a).

nodes.label: Product discounts (P&L basis)
nodes.formula: Discounts ex-GST. Memo: already deducted inside gross_sales (D-09a), so not subtracted again in net sales.

nodes.label: Product exchange cost (P&L basis)
nodes.formula: Net cost of exchange fulfilment: replacement product cost less credits and recovered stock, plus exchange shipping and handling (D-01).

nodes.label: Product exchange price adjustment (P&L basis)
nodes.formula: Exchange value difference (replacement minus exchanged item), ex-GST, on the original sale (D-01a).

nodes.label: Product gross sales (P&L basis)
nodes.formula: Gross sales ex-GST at placement, after discounts (D-09a); the top line. Excludes shipping charged.

nodes.label: Product net cogs (P&L basis)
nodes.formula: Net COGS = product cost + operating cost + exchange cost, net of returns.

nodes.label: Product net sales (P&L basis)
nodes.formula: Net sales ex-GST = gross sales + shipping revenue − cancelled − RTO − returned − shipping reversed ± exchange price adjustment.

nodes.label: Product product cogs credit (P&L basis)
nodes.formula: Product cost credited back for every cancelled / RTO / returned unit (D-03a); follows its deduction on the event axis (D-30).

nodes.label: Product product cost (P&L basis)
nodes.formula: Product cost net of the restock credit.

nodes.label: Product provisional ops cost (P&L basis)
nodes.formula: Provisional one-lump operating cost estimate used until the actual split is posted (cost_status provisional).

nodes.label: Product return cancel revenue (P&L basis)
nodes.formula: Cancelled + RTO + returned sales ex-GST: everything the old return+cancel id covered (v2 hid RTO inside it).

nodes.label: Product return revenue (P&L basis)
nodes.formula: Sales of delivered orders returned by the customer ex-GST (positive deduction).

nodes.label: Product returned or cancelled orders (P&L basis)

nodes.label: Product returned orders (P&L basis)

nodes.label: Product rto revenue (P&L basis)
nodes.formula: Sales of shipped orders that came back undelivered (RTO) ex-GST (positive deduction). Separate from cancels and returns since v3 (D-05, D-22).

nodes.label: Product shipping revenue (P&L basis)
nodes.formula: Shipping charged to the customer ex-GST, an order-level revenue line (D-10).

nodes.label: Product shipping revenue reversal (P&L basis)
nodes.formula: Shipping revenue reversed on cancelled / RTO / Unknown orders (positive deduction, D-10a).

nodes.label: Product weight discrepancy cost (P&L basis)
nodes.formula: Courier weight-discrepancy charges; not recorded before 2026-09 (D-11a).

nodes.label: Orders with the product
nodes.formula: Orders containing the product / variant (distinct root orders with a sold line). Summed over products this exceeds the order count (D-34).

nodes.label: Product packaging cost
nodes.formula: Packaging cost (placed).

nodes.label: Product payment gateway fees
nodes.formula: Payment gateway fees (placed, net as gold posts them).

nodes.label: Product refunded amount (ex-GST)

Refunds of exchanged items are excluded: exchanges never enter return metrics (D-01); the refund date is a native cash clock and ignores date_axis (D-36).

nodes.formula: Product return rate = orders with a customer-returned line of the product ÷ orders containing it. Cohort-only: refused on event_date (D-31); use order_date.

nodes.label: Product returns value (ex-GST)
nodes.formula: Returns value ex-GST of the refunded lines (refund date), splittable by product / variant / SKU. Refunds of exchanged items are excluded: exchanges never enter return metrics (D-01); the refund date is a native cash clock and ignores date_axis (D-36).

nodes.label: Product RTO cost

nodes.label: Product rto orders

nodes.label: Product shipping cost

nodes.formula: Units of customer-returned line shares (D-22).

nodes.label: Returns excl tax
nodes.formula: Returns value ex-GST, by refund date. Refunds of exchanged items are excluded: exchanges never enter return metrics (D-01); the refund date is a native cash clock and ignores date_axis (D-36).

nodes.label: RTO cost
nodes.formula: Reverse shipping cost of RTOs and returns (gold rto_cost); back-filled for legacy RTOs (D-11c).

nodes.label: Rto orders
nodes.formula: Sale orders with an RTO line (D-22).

nodes.label: Rto revenue
nodes.formula: Sales of shipped orders that came back (RTO) ex-GST (positive deduction).

nodes.label: Sample units
nodes.formula: Sample units ordered.

nodes.label: Sample units in inventory
nodes.formula: Sample units moved to inventory.

nodes.label: Sampling products
nodes.formula: Distinct sampling products.

nodes.label: Sampling variant count
nodes.formula: Sampling variants.

nodes.label: Bounce rate (sessions)
nodes.formula: Bounce rate = sessions without a product view ÷ sessions (the web_funnel bounce_rate definition), sliceable by traffic source, campaign, device and landing page.

nodes.label: Session collection views
nodes.formula: Collection views counted in session summaries.

nodes.label: Page views (sessions)
nodes.formula: Page views of web sessions, sliceable by traffic source, campaign, device and landing page (≈1.3 % below the daily mart page_views, which also counts session-less events).

nodes.label: Session product views
nodes.formula: Product views counted in session summaries (≠ product_view_events).

nodes.label: Sessions
nodes.formula: Web sessions.

nodes.label: Shipping cost
nodes.formula: Forward shipping cost (placed).

nodes.label: Shipping revenue
nodes.formula: Shipping charged to the customer ex-GST, an order-level revenue line (D-10).

nodes.label: Shipping revenue reversal
nodes.formula: Shipping revenue reversed on cancelled / RTO / Unknown orders (positive deduction, D-10a).

nodes.label: Site search events
nodes.formula: Site search events.

nodes.label: Site searches
nodes.formula: Site searches in sessions.

nodes.label: Status changes
nodes.formula: Status changes (pause / enable / archive …).

nodes.label: Stock movements
nodes.formula: Number of stock movements.

nodes.label: Stock value fifo
nodes.formula: Landed-cost value (ex-GST) of the units that sit in open FIFO receipt layers only. Today ~16 % of on-hand units are layered (the rest arrived as manual adjustments without a layer), so this UNDERSTATES total stock value; see layered_units and items_with_layer_gap.

nodes.label: Stocked items
nodes.formula: Stocked items (SKU x variant x warehouse).

nodes.label: Taxes on net sales
nodes.formula: GST on net sales, each line at its own rate; shipping at the order's line rate.

nodes.label: Thruplays
nodes.formula: ThruPlays (Meta).

nodes.label: Total sales
nodes.formula: Total sales INCLUDING GST at placement (paid + discounts); a separately labelled tax-inclusive figure (D-02b).

nodes.label: Touches
nodes.formula: Pre-purchase touches.

nodes.label: Transactions
nodes.formula: Cash payment transactions.

nodes.label: Unit return rate
nodes.formula: Unit return rate = units returned ÷ units ordered. Cohort-only: refused on event_date (D-31).

nodes.label: Units cancelled
nodes.formula: Units of cancelled line shares (D-22).

nodes.label: Units in
nodes.formula: Units added to stock (receipts, returns, positive adjustments).

nodes.label: Units ordered
nodes.formula: Units on sold lines before cancels / RTOs / returns (placement).

nodes.label: Units out
nodes.formula: Units removed from stock (sales, exchanges, negative adjustments).

nodes.label: Units per order
nodes.formula: Units ordered per order containing the product.

nodes.label: Units rto
nodes.formula: Units of RTO line shares (D-22).

nodes.label: Units sold
nodes.formula: Net units sold = units ordered − cancelled − RTO − returned.

nodes.label: Vendor count
nodes.formula: Vendors.

nodes.label: Video completion rate
nodes.formula: Video completion rate = 100% views ÷ 3-second views (Meta).

nodes.label: Web events
nodes.formula: Web events.

nodes.label: Weight discrepancy cost
nodes.formula: Courier weight-discrepancy charges; not recorded before 2026-09 (D-11a).

edges.note: A budget edit changes what the platform may spend from the next delivery hour
Pausing / enabling a campaign, ad set or ad stops or starts its spend
A new bid strategy changes how much delivery the same spend buys; platforms re-learn for days
Spend buys impressions at the auction price; CPM is the price of that mechanism (higher CPM = fewer impressions per rupee)
CTR is the mechanism: creative fatigue or audience change shows up as a CTR change
Video ads only; hook and hold rates measure the creative
Meta only; the gap is page-load loss (slow site, broken link)

Paid Meta arrivals; read on the paid / Meta slice of sessions, the rest is organic and other channels. LPV and paid Meta sessions count nearly the same arrivals in two systems, so a widening gap between them is a tracking or site-speed signal, not a cause
Paid arrivals incl. Google, which reports no landing page views
Browsing collections leads to product pages
Through checkout (add_to_cart_to_checkout_rate, checkout_to_purchase_rate); no reliable checkout count exists (checkout_steps is broken)
The store-wide conversion mechanism; crosses from the web tracker to the order ledger
Deeper discounts win orders. Discounts in rupees also scale with orders, so test the discount RATE (discounts ÷ gross_sales) as the lever, not the rupee amount, or the edge is circular
Also an accounting fact (net sales deduct discounts); the behavioural part is basket composition
Units × selling price; a price change is a change in this mechanism
New customers are first orders; the share of new vs repeat is the mechanism
COD share is the mechanism (checkout payment options, COD fees, pincode serviceability)
COD orders are cancelled far more often than prepaid ones
Return-to-origin is mostly refused COD deliveries
Order-date return metrics are incomplete for orders younger than the return window: a recent 'drop in returns' or 'rise in net sales' can be immaturity, not behaviour
Unit cost × units; a supplier price change is a change in this mechanism
Per-shipment rate × orders; a courier rate change is a change in this mechanism
Today's new customers are the repeat customers of the coming months
Budget decisions follow results; value-based bidding spends more where it converts
Conversion-optimised campaigns pace spend on conversions
Conversion signal improves auction outcomes
